ideas.title: Investigation into Trump Administration's Handling of Renee Good Shooting
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Trump administration's handling of the Renee Good shooting investigation, including their decision to order prosecutors to stop investigating.
questions: What was the Trump administration's involvement in the Renee Good shooting investigation?
Did the Trump administration obstruct justice by ordering prosecutors to stop investigating?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing by the Trump administration and highlight the need for accountability. By following the money and investigating the administration's handling of the Renee Good shooting, we may uncover a larger pattern of obstruction of justice.
